use crate::api::client::ApiClient;
use crate::models::{ResultWithDefaultError, TimeEntry};
use crate::utilities;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

pub struct InvoiceMonthlyCommand;

impl InvoiceMonthlyCommand {
    pub async fn execute(
        api_client: impl ApiClient,
        since: Option<String>,
        until: Option<String>,
    ) -> ResultWithDefaultError<()> {
        let (since, until) = utilities::normalize_time_entry_list_filters(since, until)?;
        let entries = api_client
            .get_time_entries_filtered_minimal(since, until)
            .await?;
        let months = monthly_billable_seconds(&entries);

        if months.is_empty() {
            println!("(no data)");
            return Ok(());
        }

        let total: i64 = months.values().sum();
        for (month, seconds) in months {
            println!("{month}  {seconds}s");
        }
        println!("Total  {total}s");
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn monthly_billable_seconds(entries: &[TimeEntry]) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
    let mut months = BTreeMap::new();
    for entry in entries {
        if entry.billable && !entry.is_running() {
            let month = entry.start.format("%Y-%m").to_string();
            *months.entry(month).or_insert(0) += entry.duration.max(0);
        }
    }
    months
}

#[cfg(test)]
mod tests {
    use super::monthly_billable_seconds;
    use crate::models::TimeEntry;
    use chrono::{DateTime, Utc};

    fn entry(start: &str, duration: i64, billable: bool, stop: bool) -> TimeEntry {
        TimeEntry {
            id: 1,
            description: String::new(),
            start: start.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>().unwrap(),
            stop: stop.then_some(start.parse::<DateTime<Utc>>().unwrap()),
            duration,
            billable,
            workspace_id: 1,
            tags: Vec::new(),
            project: None,
            task: None,
            created_with: None,
        }
    }

    #[test]
    fn groups_billable_completed_entries_by_utc_start_month() {
        let entries = vec![
            entry("2026-02-01T00:30:00Z", 20, true, true),
            entry("2026-01-31T23:30:00-02:00", 30, true, true),
            entry("2026-02-03T00:00:00Z", 40, false, true),
            entry("2026-02-04T00:00:00Z", -1, true, false),
        ];

        let result = monthly_billable_seconds(&entries);
        assert_eq!(result.get("2026-02"), Some(&50));
        assert_eq!(result.len(), 1);
    }

    #[test]
    fn excludes_non_billable_and_running_entries() {
        let entries = vec![
            entry("2026-01-01T00:00:00Z", 10, false, true),
            entry("2026-01-02T00:00:00Z", -10, true, false),
        ];

        assert!(monthly_billable_seconds(&entries).is_empty());
    }
}

use crate::api::client::ApiClient;
use crate::models::{ResultWithDefaultError, TimeEntry};
use crate::utilities;
use std::collections::BTreeMap;

pub struct InvoiceMonthlyCommand;

impl InvoiceMonthlyCommand {
    pub async fn execute(
        api_client: impl ApiClient,
        since: Option<String>,
        until: Option<String>,
        json: bool,
    ) -> ResultWithDefaultError<()> {
        let (since, until) = utilities::normalize_time_entry_list_filters(since, until)?;
        let entries = api_client
            .get_time_entries_filtered_minimal(since, until)
            .await?;
        let months = monthly_billable_seconds(&entries);
        let total: i64 = months.values().sum();

        if json {
            let months = months
                .into_iter()
                .map(|(month, billable_seconds)| {
                    serde_json::json!({
                        "month": month,
                        "billable_seconds": billable_seconds,
                    })
                })
                .collect::<Vec<_>>();
            println!(
                "{}",
                serde_json::json!({
                    "months": months,
                    "total_billable_seconds": total,
                })
            );
            return Ok(());
        }

        if months.is_empty() {
            println!("(no data)");
            return Ok(());
        }

        for (month, seconds) in months {
            println!("{month}  {seconds}s");
        }
        println!("Total  {total}s");
        Ok(())
    }
}

fn monthly_billable_seconds(entries: &[TimeEntry]) -> BTreeMap<String, i64> {
    let mut months = BTreeMap::new();
    for entry in entries {
        if entry.billable && !entry.is_running() {
            let month = entry.start.format("%Y-%m").to_string();
            *months.entry(month).or_insert(0) += entry.duration.max(0);
        }
    }
    months
}
